subject.title: fix(media): apply SSRF guard to byteplus and runway generated video downloads

question: Should OpenClaw accept `fetchGuardedProviderDownloadResponse` as a public `plugin-sdk/provider-http` contract for default-deny generated-asset downloads?
rationale: The security fix needs a shared core-to-plugin seam, but exporting it makes its return, retry, timeout, and release semantics a lasting plugin API rather than a local implementation detail.

options.title: Accept the narrow SDK seam
options.body: Keep the exported guarded-download helper and use it as the canonical retrying, releasable, default-deny media-download path for provider plugins.

options.title: Choose a different public seam
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-defined alternative before merge if the repository does not want this helper's current result and lifetime contract exposed to plugins.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the exported guarded-download helper and use it as the canonical retrying, releasable, default-deny media-download path for provider plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged sibling provider-policy work is the strongest available history signal for the intended guarded follow-up request boundary.
